verdict: FEASIBLE_WITH_EXISTING_UPSTREAM_CRYPTO; implementation and runtime acceptance pending
conclusions: Pinned tlsn exposes TranscriptCommitConfig, ProveConfig::transcript_commit, ProverOutput commitments plus secrets, and VerifierOutput commitments. The existing Forge worker currently drops those outputs.

Verifier commitments come from authenticated TLS plaintext references and MPC evaluation, not a prover-supplied digest. Export only the finalized VerifierOutput commitments after upstream acceptance and exact application policy checks.

For SHA256, the exact pinned construction is SHA256(concat plaintext in canonical range order || 16-byte random blinder). Direction, ranges and algorithm are fields of PlaintextHash, not included in that digest preimage. They must remain bound by the signed/persisted record.

Hidden transcript lengths need no trusted peer length declaration: upstream compares partial transcript lengths with collected TLS application ciphertext lengths and verifies plaintext proofs. Preserve the explicit empty reveal so lengths remain available without hidden plaintext disclosure.
No new MPC/TLS/notary/TEE or FairSwap implementation is needed to expose this bounded mechanism. Persisted direct-verifier observations are not a portable independently verifiable TLS attestation.

minimum_acceptance_properties.requirement: MPC only; both roles enforce independently configured server identity and roots; export verifier-side finalized upstream commitments, reject proxy/plain HTTPS substitution.

Before expensive upstream accept, enforce algorithm, commitment count, exact canonical direction/ranges and disclosure mask. Resolve end sentinel against upstream-authenticated total lengths, not a peer length. Reject missing/extra/reordered/duplicate/unknown commitments.

Only prover result contains secret openings. Verifier result, public persisted evidence and diagnostics contain no blinder or hidden response/request. Opening only intended response ranges must never export the request API key.

Use the existing Forge digest primitive with exact upstream construction. Match direction/algorithm/canonical ranges/digest, exact concatenated data length, transcript bounds and full opening coverage; reject altered bytes, blinder, digest, length, direction and unknown algorithm.

Actual local integration must show buyer obtains and persists hidden-response commitments, signs a canonical domain-separated context/evidence record with existing Forge signature support, seller validates that exact signature and only then releases opening/hidden bytes. A library record alone does not enforce this external flow.

Bounded, exact, versioned roundtrip of verifier evidence and separate sensitive prover openings; reject tail/truncation/unknown version. Bind origin, authenticated lengths, upstream pin/protocol, complete commitment metadata and caller replay context in signed data. Persisted arbitrary user input must never be upgraded to freshly MPC-verified provenance.

Explicit private worker protocol version/magic agreement; old/new mismatched workers fail closed. C++ and Rust caps/enum/length validation agree; install and exercise a fresh external consumer using installed modules and installed worker only.

Keep existing absolute deadline/cancel/backpressure/drain/reap ownership. Bound nested commitment/opening allocations and retained capacities before copies; no payload diagnostics or implicit source retry.

required_negative_evidence: wrong independent origin or trust root
wrong commitment algorithm/direction/range/count or omitted commitment
different hidden length, incomplete open, mutated opening bytes/blinder/hash
buyer signature over changed evidence or context, no valid signature means no hidden release
public verifier/persisted evidence and logs do not contain API-key/hidden body/blinder sentinels
installed consumer with actual localhost HTTPS MPC and opening after restart/roundtrip
